templateGallery.description: Choose a template to pre-fill the create form. You can customise all fields after applying — templates are starting points, not fixed definitions.
wizard.title: Getting Started
wizardConn.connectionCreated: Connection created. Proceed to the next step.
wizardConn.intro: Create a connection to your data source. This tells Tessallite how to reach your database.
wizardConn.selectProjectFirst: Select or create a project first before adding a connection.
wizardConnectBI.body: Tessallite exposes your model via JDBC and XMLA so any BI tool can query it directly.
wizardConnectBI.footer: Use your Tessallite login credentials to authenticate. The model slug is the database name for JDBC connections.
wizardConnectBI.seeHelp: See the help library for tool-specific setup guides.
wizardConnectBI.title: Connect Your BI Tool
wizardModel.body: A model defines how your data is structured for analytics.
wizardModel.dimensionsDesc: are columns used for grouping and filtering.
wizardModel.dimensionsItem: Dimensions are columns used for grouping and filtering.
wizardModel.footer: Open the Model Builder to define your measures and dimensions, then return here to continue.
wizardModel.fullBody: A model defines how your data is structured for analytics. Create at least one measure (a numeric fact like revenue or count) and one dimension (an attribute to group by, like region or date).
wizardModel.joinsDesc: link tables together — e.g., orders to customers via customer_id.
wizardModel.joinsItem: Joins link tables together — e.g., orders to customers via customer_id.
wizardModel.measuresDesc: are numeric columns with an aggregation (SUM, COUNT, AVG, etc.).
wizardModel.measuresItem: Measures are numeric columns with an aggregation (SUM, COUNT, AVG, etc.).
wizardModel.title: Build Your Model
wizardQuery.body: Open the Query Panel in the Model Builder to execute a simple query.
wizardQuery.openQuery: Open the Query Panel in the Model Builder to execute a simple query. Select a measure and a dimension, then click Execute to see your data.
wizardQuery.semantic: The query is routed through the semantic layer — Tessallite resolves your measure and dimension definitions into SQL, checks for pre-built aggregates, and returns the result.
wizardQuery.title: Run Your First Query
wizardSource.body: Select tables from your connection to add them as sources in your model.
wizardSource.moreSources: You can add more sources later from the Model Builder. For now, add at least one table to continue.
wizardSource.selectTables: Select tables from your connection to add them as sources in your model. Sources are the raw tables that contain your business data — fact tables with transactions and dimension tables with attributes.
wizardSource.title: Add Data Sources
wizardWelcome.body: Tessallite is a semantic layer and analytics platform that sits between your data sources and your BI tools.
wizardWelcome.connectionConcept: Connection — credentials for a data source (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Spark, etc.).
wizardWelcome.connectionDesc: credentials for a data source (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Spark, etc.).
wizardWelcome.dimensionConcept: Dimension — an attribute you slice and group by (region, product category, date).
wizardWelcome.dimensionDesc: an attribute you slice and group by (region, product category, date).
wizardWelcome.measureConcept: Measure — a numeric fact you want to analyse (revenue, order count, etc.).
wizardWelcome.measureDesc: a numeric fact you want to analyse (revenue, order count, etc.).
wizardWelcome.modelConcept: Model — a collection of tables, measures, dimensions, and hierarchies that describe your business data.
wizardWelcome.modelDesc: a collection of tables, measures, dimensions, and hierarchies that describe your business data.
wizardWelcome.platformDescription: Tessallite is a semantic layer and analytics platform that sits between your data sources and your BI tools. It lets you define business measures, dimensions, and hierarchies once, then query them from any tool — Excel, Power BI, DBeaver, or via API.
wizardWelcome.projectConcept: Project — a workspace that groups one or more semantic models under a single tenant.
wizardWelcome.projectDesc: a workspace that groups one or more semantic models under a single tenant.
wizardWelcome.title: Welcome to Tessallite
wizardWelcome.wizardIntro: This wizard walks you through connecting a data source, building a simple model, and running your first query.
